direct_ancestors.description: Note: The original copy of the file raw/Cyc10_reg1/1_00025_Z011_CH1.tif was corrupted. To enable downstream analysis, the researchers replaced raw/Cyc10_reg1/1_00025_Z011_CH1.tif with an exact copy of the image from the adjacent stack: raw/Cyc10_reg1/1_00025_Z010_CH1.tif. Given that this represents an out of focus area, the expected effect on the overall results is minimal.

ingest_metadata.workflow_description: The CODEX pipeline performs illumination correction and other pre-processing steps, segments nuclei and cells using Cytokit, and performs spatial analysis of expression data using SPRM, which computes various measures of analyte intensity per cell, performs clustering based on expression and other data, and computes markers for each cluster.

title: CODEX [Cytokit + SPRM] data from the small intestine of a 37-year-old white male
